"Entered according to Act of Congress in the year 1898, by H.G. Chalkley, in the Office of the Librarian of Congress at Washington." Relief shown by hachures. Includes 9 relief profiles and index to departments. Insets: Port of Corinto -- Port of San Juan del Norte -- Port of San Juan del Sur. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Two copies.
